text:
The court will most likely uphold the statute as constitutional. The state has a legitimate interest in ensuring that a candidate shows a modicum of support before reaching the ballot, and the 20% party threshold and the 180-day deadline (shared with party candidates) are neutral and objective. The 7% petition requirement is the most vulnerable element, since it is higher than the 5% upheld in *Jenness v. Fortson*, but it is likely to survive under the *Anderson-Burdick* balancing test.

CONFIDENCE: 65
